ios.desc:
Sutāto is the only emulator crafted specifically for playing NES and Gameboy games on your iPhone and iPad.

With unparalleled speed and precision, Sutāto faithfully replicates nearly every aspect of the original hardware, delivering an authentic gaming experience like no other.

FEATURES:

Seamless usability: With an intuitive interface, Sutāto makes it effortless to navigate and start playing your favorite Gameboy and NES titles.

Customization options: Tailor your experience with a variety of video and audio filters.

Save at any moment: Resume your game from where you left off with auto-save functionality.

Relive your classics: Enjoy your beloved NES and Gameboy favorites on your iOS device, whether you're on the go or relaxing at home.

Controller Support: Connect your preferred controller for play with your favorite NES titles.

Wiki in Game: Discover the History Behind Your Favorite Games.

No ads: Sutāto is ad-free, ensuring uninterrupted gaming sessions without any limitations.

Note: 
Sutāto and its developer(s) are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the companies that created the gaming console.
